title: Bigelow refuses to return; negative experiences hit his family

tellings.quote: he had such negative experiences. It it impacted his family.

plain: Robert Bigelow, a businessman who once owned Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for strange reports, is said to refuse to go back there because of the bad things he went through, which also hurt his family. The ranch's current owner tells this on the show, citing Bigelow and the journalist George Knapp: "he had such negative experiences. It impacted his family." If true, it would mean whatever is at the ranch can harm the people who deal with it.
